name: safevtube
description: Safe-by-default PNGtuber/VTuber toolkit: mic-reactive avatars, expression hotkeys, OBS overlay, Twitch chat triggers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @safevtube/server" "npm run dev -w @safevtube/web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @safevtube/server
